movers-week.hint: Monday is the first day of the school week.
movers-week.fact: A week has seven days — Sunday to Saturday.

movers-weekend.definition: Saturday and Sunday when there is no school.
movers-weekend.definitionVi: Cuối tuần — thứ Bảy và Chủ nhật.
movers-weekend.fact: Weekends are great for hobbies and trips.

movers-well.hint: Say "I am well" when you feel fine.
movers-well.fact: Eating well and sleeping help you stay well.

movers-wet.fact: Wet paint signs warn you not to touch.

movers-whale.definition: A huge sea mammal that breathes air.
movers-whale.definitionVi: Cá voi — động vật biển khổng lồ.
movers-whale.hint: It spouts water from a blowhole.
movers-whale.fact: Blue whales are the largest animals ever.

movers-when.fact: When is one of the five W question words.

movers-wind.hint: Wind makes trees sway and kites fly.
movers-wind.fact: Strong wind can turn windmill blades.

movers-windy.definition: With a lot of wind blowing.
movers-windy.hint: Hold your hat on a windy day.
movers-windy.fact: Windy days are perfect for flying kites.

movers-work.definition: A job or task you do.
movers-work.hint: Homework is work you do at home.
movers-work.fact: Many grown-ups go to work every weekday.

movers-world.definition: The planet Earth and all its countries.
movers-world.definitionVi: Thế giới — Trái Đất và các quốc gia.
movers-world.hint: People live all around the world.
movers-world.fact: The world has oceans, mountains, and deserts.

movers-worse.hint: A cold feels worse than a sniffle.
movers-worse.fact: Comparing helps you choose the better option.

movers-worst.hint: The worst score is the lowest one.
movers-worst.fact: Even the worst day can teach you something.

movers-would.definition: to talk about wishes or polite offers.
movers-would.definitionVi: Dùng nói mong muốn hoặc lời mời lịch sự.
movers-would.fact: Would is softer and politer than will.

movers-wrong.hint: Cross out the wrong answer and try again.
movers-wrong.fact: Learning from wrong answers helps you improve.

movers-yesterday.definitionVi: Hôm qua — ngày trước hôm nay.
movers-yesterday.hint: Yesterday is already in the past.
movers-yesterday.fact: You cannot change what happened yesterday.
